The text was extracted from PDFs or HTML; some PDF text layers break lam-alef ligatures (e.g. 'علاج' extracts as 'عالج', 'تلاش' as 'تالش'). Those were normalised in the evidence, and rendered-page checks were done where needed (US Census glossary, Ontario seniors dental brochure). Confidence: high = 2+ independent authoritative sources agree OR 1 official side-by-side translation; medium = 1 authoritative source or established media usage; low = dictionaries only.

correctionsToRecheck.issue: [major] Health card is translated as 'صحت کا کارڈ'. Sourced term is 'ہیلتھ کارڈ' (City of Toronto Ontario Works sheet, SickKids, NSW Health), and the corrector already uses ہیلتھ کارڈ in 8f3b8610ff41 and b9bf5f163902. [minor] 'آبادکاری میں مدد' should match the other texts' 'سیٹلمنٹ'. [minor] 'خفیہ' for confidential: attested, but the sourced majority is 'رازدارانہ'. [minor] 'واک ان' is not attested; sources say 'اپائنٹمنٹ کی ضرورت نہیں'.

[major] 'illegal lockouts' is rendered 'غیر قانونی طور پر تالے لگانا' (= illegally putting on locks). Sourced wording describes being shut out: 'گھر سے باہر بند کر دینا' (NY Attorney General) or 'تالے تبدیل کرنا' (Maryland DHCD). Suggest e.g. 'غیر قانونی طور پر گھر سے باہر بند کر دینا (lockout)'. [minor] 'ذاتی ملاقات کے لیے پہلے سے وقت لینا' is fine Urdu, but sources use 'اپائنٹمنٹ'.

[major] Midwifery clinic is rendered 'دائی گیری کا کلینک' and midwives 'دائیوں'. All three health-system sources (NHS Sussex, SWBH NHS, Royal Women's Melbourne) use 'مڈوائف' and give 'دائی' only as a bracketed gloss. Suggest 'مڈوائف کلینک' / 'مڈوائفز (دائیاں)'.

[major] Dentures are rendered 'مصنوعی دانت'. Ontario's own seniors-dental brochure (and NHS Scotland) uses 'ڈینچر/ڈینچرز'. This text describes OSDCP-type public dental care, so Ontario's wording should be followed.

[major] The designated cooling space is rendered 'ٹھنڈک کی جگہ (کولنگ اسپیس)'. City of Toronto's own Urdu Beat the Heat material calls Cool Spaces 'ٹھنڈی جگہ/ٹھنڈی جگہیں'; the loan 'کولنگ اسپیس' is unattested. [minor] 'شدید گرمی کی وارننگ یا الرٹ' uses 'وارننگ', which no translated source has; sources use 'انتباہ'.

[major] 'کولنگ سینٹر' (cooling centre) and 'کرائسس لائن' (crisis line) are unattested loans. Sourced equivalents are 'ٹھنڈک کا مرکز' (NY Governor's office; NYC EM 'ٹھنڈے مراکز') and 'ہیلپ لائن' (GOV.UK). [minor] 'مشاورت' for VAW counselling; sources use 'کاؤنسلنگ'.
